speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I need to evaluate your skin lesion carefully; can you describe its color, size, and how quickly it has changed in appearance?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (Penis and Finger).

The history of heavy smoking, African origin, and multiple non-healing, erythematous, crusty lesions in sun-exposed and mucosal sites strongly suggests cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma with potential metastasis. Given the high suspicion for malignancy, I am proceeding with a biopsy. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile and digital lesions.
